evals.prompt:

[Eval setup — not part of the user's message: from the skill folder, run every job-scout script with JOB_SCOUT_REPLAY_DIR=evals/files/worlds/day1 and JOB_SCOUT_HOME set to a new empty temp directory. evals.expected_output: The brief saves work_modes [remote] and remote_scope [US], then the search runs on the four replayed boards. The Reactive Markets Senior Frontend Engineer (Remote, UK) is not in the results table; it may appear under close but excluded with a reason saying remote is limited to the UK. The Kobold Metals Frontend Software Engineer (Remote, North America), if shown, carries an Americas flag. Every link opens the job on the employer's own job page.
assertions: Runs scripts/probe.py with JOB_SCOUT_REPLAY_DIR pointing at evals/files/worlds/day1 and the four-board --boards list
Saves a profile with work_modes ["remote"] and remote_scope including "US"
The Reactive Markets 'Senior Frontend Engineer' (Remote, UK) is not a row in the results table
If the Reactive Markets job is mentioned at all, it is under close but excluded with a reason saying remote is limited to the UK (GB)
If the Kobold Metals 'Frontend Software Engineer' (Remote, North America) is shown, its row or notes carry a flag such as 'Americas — check US eligibility'

Every link in the table is an https employer job page (job-boards.greenhouse.io, jobs.ashbyhq.com or the employer's own site), never an aggregator (Indeed, LinkedIn, ZipRecruiter, Glassdoor and similar) and never an API address
Shows only jobs that scripts/fetch_jd.py reported as open

assertions: Shows the brief table even though the user asked to skip questions
Every value the user did not provide is labelled default or inferred, not presented as confirmed
